 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr.Nadimul Hasan, Adv  For the Opposite Party/s : Mr.Kumar Ranjit Ranjan, APP  ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE JUSTICE SMT. SONI SHRIVASTAVA
ORAL ORDER 4 11-04-2025 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and the State.
2. Petitioner apprehends his arrest in connection with Complaint Case No, 340 of 2024 registered for the offences punishable under Sections 498A of the Indian Penal Code.
3. Let the matter be sent to Mediation Centre, Patna High Court, Patna.
Both the parties are ready to appear before the Mediation Centre on 24.04.2025 and resolve the dispute amicably through mediation process.

4. The Mediation Centre, Patna High Court, Patna is directed to explore the possibilities of resolving the dispute of the parties and send its report within four weeks from the date of Patna High Court CR.
MISC. No.77445 of 2024(4) dt.11-04-2025 initiation of proceeding

. 
5. Let this matter be listed on 13.05.2025 or after receipt of report of learned Mediator, Mediation Centre, Patna High Court, Patna, whichever is earlier.
(Soni Shrivastava, J) N.K/-
